task: Find the latest Diffusion-related blog on Hugging Face, and read its intro or overview section to roughly summarize the content of the blog.
answer: The latest Diffusion-related blog on Hugging Face is 'Waypoint-1.5: Higher-Fidelity Interactive Worlds for Everyday GPUs' (published April 9, 2026, https://huggingface.co/blog/waypoint-1-5). Summary of its intro/overview: Waypoint-1.5 is Overworld's next real-time video world model (diffusion-based) for interactive generative worlds. It improves visual fidelity and accessibility: it runs in real time at up to 720p/60 FPS on RTX 3090-5090 desktop GPUs and adds a new 360p tier for broader consumer hardware such as gaming laptops (with Apple Silicon Mac support coming soon). It was trained on roughly 100x more data than Waypoint-1, yielding more coherent environments and more consistent motion, and uses more efficient video-modeling techniques that reduce redundant computation across frames.
